resources.string:
The greeting is a recording by Maya Hinanogi. The coffee order was recorded by Rieko (huizi99) for Tatoeba and is used under CC BY-NC 4.0.

Other dialogue and pronunciation clips are excerpts from the JSUT corpus, University of Tokyo. The recordings were trimmed and volume-adjusted. Two replies combine excerpts from the same speaker. This private lesson uses the corpus under its personal-use terms. Commercial use requires separate permission.

JSUT source recordings: travel1000 (0011, 0022, 0067, 0170, 0550, 0611, 0755, 0810, 0819) and utparaphrase512 (sent124, phrase1). Travel text is adapted from English–Japanese Translation Alignment Data, CC BY-SA 3.0. The saved-word excerpts from SNOW E4 use CC BY 4.0 for the text.
